verdict.rationale: Graphite's review agent is described as codebase-aware, and Graphite Chat can find related files, explain dependencies, and pull context from other PRs. Stacking also breaks large changes into smaller reviewable PRs, which helps reviewers follow big monorepo changes coherently. Its multi-repo support is only an inbox for tracking PRs across many repos, though, and there is no evidence of reviewing a single change set that spans repositories. missing for 10: explicit cross-repository change correlation/review, documented monorepo-scale codebase understanding (e.g. indexing or ownership-aware analysis), independent or hands-on corroboration of large-codebase review quality.
